clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale, Mastok Wrilehiss helps hold the Horde’s ground. He directs scouts and warriors to watch nearby borders and confront corrupting elemental forces amid the night elves’ hostility.

Deep beneath Ashenvale’s canopy, Splintertree Post is surrounded by hostile night elf territory. Mastok Wrilehiss helps defend the outpost and watches its supply routes and the forest around it. The Sentinels see the settlement as an intrusion that despoils their lands, and they strike quickly at any sign of weakness.

From within the stockade, Mastok gives passing adventurers duties tied to the Horde’s defense. He watches the borders toward the Stonetalon Mountains and sends scouts to speak with shamans such as Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring at Zoram'gar Strand. His work also follows the strange corruption afflicting local elementals.
